locations.name: The Reach
locations.description: The pocket of space beyond the Needle: the Caul system and its outer belts.

children.name: Hollin
children.description: Cold moon of Caul; salt and glass.

children.name: Tallow
children.description: The first and largest town on Hollin, dug down into the salt. Tallow Under, in the Compact; a half-ruin held by the Lantern in the Ebb.

children.name: Lantern Row
children.description: Tallow's street of bars.

children.name: The Lantern
children.description: A cutters' bar on Lantern Row.

children.name: Shaft Nine
children.description: The deepest glass shaft under Tallow; collapsed in 2286.

children.name: The Assembly Hall
children.description: The Concession's meeting hall, later the Compact Hall where the Draw is held and the Tally hangs.

children.name: The Asante apartment
children.description: The Speaker's family rooms on the Terrace level of Tallow Under.

children.name: The Gutter
children.description: The outer ring of Tallow in the Ebb, where the bone-pickers live.

children.name: The Lantern House
children.description: The Lamplighter's seat in the Ebb, the old Assembly offices.

children.name: The Pans
children.description: Salt flats on Hollin's surface; the shuttle field.

children.name: Caul
children.description: The gas giant.

children.name: Anchorage Station
children.description: The station at the Needle's mouth. Anchorage (Concession), the Anchorhold (Compact), the Anchor (Ebb).

children.name: The Lectern
children.description: The observatory where the harp is played; later the harp hall.

children.name: Dock Four
children.description: The tug dock.

children.name: The Director's Gallery
children.description: Hesper Vane's office and gallery overlooking the Needle; later the High Warden's sanctum.

children.name: The archive
children.description: The Wardens' archive of harp records.

children.name: The reliquary
children.description: Where the Wardens keep the Founder's Fork.

children.name: The cells
children.description: Security cells, later the Wardens' penitents' cells.

children.name: The Needle
children.description: The wormhole. Its mouth, its throat, its waist.

children.name: The throat
children.description: The passage inside the Needle; its narrowest point is the waist.

children.name: The Ossuary
children.description: Where the Returns drift near the Needle's mouth, in the Ebb.

children.name: The Shoals
children.description: The outer belt habitats.

children.name: Corrie Rock
children.description: A neutral rock in the Shoals where smugglers meet.
